prompts.q: put denver in the station fields and tick station name
set the location to united states
set the precip value to gauge catch, the operator to >= and the value to 0.5, then search
go to the next page of results

prompts.check: (card) => { const m = document.body.innerText.match(/of\s+([\d,]+)\s+Records/i); if (!m) return false; const n = m[1].replace(/,/g, ""); const t = [card.title, card.sub, card.answer].join(" ").replace(/,/g, ""); return t.includes(n); }

prompts.q: what report date is being searched
prompts.check: (card) => { const m = document.body.innerText.match(/Report date on\s+(\d{1,2}\/\d{1,2}\/\d{4})/i); if (!m) return false; const t = [card.title, card.sub, card.answer].join(" "); const [mo, d] = m[1].split("/"); const months = ["january","february","march","april","may","june","july","august","september","october","november","december"]; return t.includes(m[1]) || new RegExp(months[+mo - 1] + "\\s+" + (+d) + "\\b", "i").test(t); }

prompts.q: which station reported the highest gauge catch on this page
prompts.check: (card) => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll("table tr")].map((tr) => [...tr.children].map((td) => td.textContent.trim())).filter((r) => r.length > 6 && /^\d{1,2}\/\d{1,2}\/\d{4}$/.test(r[0])); if (!rows.length) return false; let best = null; for (const r of rows) { const v = parseFloat(r[4]); if (!isNaN(v) && (!best || v > best.v)) best = { v, num: r[2], name: r[3] }; } if (!best) return false; const t = [card.title, card.sub, card.answer].join(" ").toLowerCase(); return t.includes(best.num.toLowerCase()) || t.includes(best.name.toLowerCase().split(" ")[0]); }
